name: Touchi Aoi
source:
Profession: Talent Manager
Hobby: Writing a Diary
Favorite food: Jello Drinks, Food Fried in Garlic
Disliked food: Pickles/Vinegared Food, Umeboshi

The oldest of the three sisters.
She was originally only Kou's manager, but certain circumstances made her interested in Yuu and she became the manager of the temporary unit "GeMiNi."
She has a strong sense of responsibility and is a firm person with a helpful personality.
Because she has two younger sisters she's nice to people who are younger than her.
